Name: The Last Supper
Notes:
(Jun 29, 1993) Oliver Tree is born in Santa Cruz, California
(Jun 20, 2010) Oliver begins posting music to Soundcloud under the pseudonym 'Kryph'

Name:
Ja Break
(prod. Getter & Oliver Tree)
Notes: Demo of Getter and Kryph's track Ja Break, briefly posted to Getter's Soundcloud a month before the track's release. This demo lacks the vocal samples from 'Crazy' and is mixed differently.

Name:
Once It's Gone [Demo / Freestyle]
(prod. Samson Stilwell)
Notes: A recording of Oliver freestyling over the Once It's Gone beat, posted to Youtube by Getter three days before the track's release. A few of the lyrics from this freestyle were used in the song, and some were also later reused in Next Level Shit.

Name:
Once It's Gone [Update]
(feat. Dready Black)
(prod. Samson Stilwell)
Notes: According to a comment made by Kryph under the Soundcloud upload of Once It's Gone, he intended to release a "full version" of the track a few weeks later. Dready Black posted a preview snippet of the track to his Soundcloud a few days after the release with updated mixing, presumably from this finished mix. However, the full finished version never surfaced.

Smell You Later [V1]
(prod. Getter & Oliver Tree)
Notes:
OG Filename: Smell You Later (ft. Getter)
Unreleased track produced around 2010-2011, sent to a fan by Oliver. This song was later considered for Oliver and Getter's scrapped mixtape 'Squirt'.

Name:
Tully
(feat. Kirsten Rosenberg)
(prod. Shelf Nunny & Oliver Tree)
Notes: As shown through the Wayback Machine, an earlier version of Tully was once available on Oliver's Soundcloud, but was replaced when the finished version was published, and has not been recovered.

Name: Untitled Freestyle*
Notes: Recording of Oliver freestyling at a birthday party, posted to Youtube by Getter in 2010. Some of the lyrics from this were reused in Session, and later again in the unreleased track Spotlights.

Name:
Clint Eastwood (Gorillaz Remix) [Update]
(prod. Getter & Oliver Tree)
Notes: As suggested by the 'UNMASTERED' tag in the title of his remix, Oliver mentioned in the comments on Soundcloud that he was making a mastered version of his Clint Eastwood remix, to be included in his upcoming mixtape 'The Last Supper', which was never released. This updated mix has never surfaced.

Originally intended to drop as a solo track in 2023, Bebe Rexha's 'Nevermind' was scrapped for a while, but was revisited in 2024 with a verse by Oliver Tree added. Notes: In the final days before his passing, Oliver recorded multiple songs with Lucas Frota in a studio in Brazil. Victor WAO and DUPÊ were also present for at least some of these recordings, as well as DUPÊ's girlfriend, who posted a recording of Oliver rapping for one of the tracks. "Fuck Me With Your Sor-*" listed above is from these sessions. The sessions took place on June 12th & 13th 2026 - tragically, both Oliver and Lucas Frota lost their lives in a helicopter collision the following day.
